owner_decision: The operational guide is accepted as semantically equivalent to the locked protocol for operational annotation use. It may use the same decontaminated fictional examples as the frozen O-5 model prompt, so the model and human annotators receive the same annotation codebook and examples, provided those examples are not evaluation material.
locked_protocol_role: Historical locked design record and governing rule source. Not decontaminated, not modified, and not the guide shown to blinded annotators.
freeze_change: Only the guide's status line changed at freeze (CANDIDATE_DECONTAMINATED_GUIDE -> FROZEN_OPERATIONAL_GUIDE). The verifier reconstructs the candidate from the frozen guide and checks it against candidate_guide_sha256, which the candidate review records.
change_record_note: Kept byte-identical to the reviewed version. Its status fields (CANDIDATE_DECONTAMINATED_GUIDE, PROPOSED_NOT_APPLIED) are the state at review; this manifest and HARNESS_AMENDMENT_002 supersede them.
contamination_audit_method: O-5 audit corpus and rule unchanged (scripts/verify_engine3_stage_f_o5_freeze.py evaluation_corpus, compare, banned_terms) plus shared distinctive 4-grams; worked-example tolerance zero; whole-guide sentence findings must be allowlisted with a reason in the change record.
same_examples_as_frozen_o5_prompt: Every example sentence the model prompt also contains is identical; the remaining fragments are human-only section 7.0 examples or the same values in different markup.
claim_boundary: A frozen presentation of locked annotation rules with decontaminated examples. Passing the audit shows the examples do not match the evaluation corpus under a fixed token rule; it does not show annotators will be uninfluenced. Not evidence of annotation reliability, model quality, semantic validation, purchase prediction, sales lift, production security, or BAEC theory.
